definition: [ אֲלֻמָּה ] noun feminine sheaf , in Joseph's dream Gen 37:7 (4 t. in verse) ( E ) followed by suffix אֲלֻמָּתִי , plural אֲלֻמִּים , אֲלֻמֹּתֵיכֶם ; also Ps 126:6 אֲלֻמֹּתָיו (in figurative of ret. from captivity).
